entries.role: fuel type layer for spread fires with fire_year <= 2014 (capability_2_fire_spread currently uses the 2024 map for every fire)
entries.vintage_basis: metadata PDF (read 2026-11-02): built from Land Cover Map of Canada 2011 (MODIS, 250 m), CanFI2000, provincial inventories; ecozones with NFDB/NBAC burn scars (the PDF cites NFDB 2016)
entries.licence: Open Government Licence - Canada, per https://cwfis.cfs.nrcan.gc.ca/downloads/licence.txt (tree-wide CWFIS downloads licence; applies to this archive by location, not confirmed in its own metadata)
entries.retrieval: HEAD request only on 2026-11-02; archive NOT downloaded
entries.year_selection_rule: fire_year <= 2014 -> use this layer (Team Lead approved)
entries.availability_notes: The layer was published long after the 2012-2014 fires; it is a retrospective stand-in, not the map that existed on each fire's date. Its burn-scar step cites NFDB 2016, so for 2012-2014 fires the burn scar of the fire itself may already be masked; this needs a leakage check on the fuel inside each fire perimeter before use.

entries.role: vegetation/fuel basis for spread fires with fire_year >= 2015
entries.file_pattern: SCANFI_att_<attribute>_<YYYY>_v2_20260119.tif (attributes include closure, height, biomass, nfiLandcover; SCANFI_spsCC_<species>_<YYYY>_v2_20260119.tif for species crown closure)
entries.vintage: SCANFI v2, 5-year epochs 1985-2025, published 2026-01-01 (catalogue date_published); file date stamp 20260119
entries.vintage_basis: Catalogue notes say 5-year intervals 1985-2025. Measured with HEAD requests on 2026-11-02: closure files for 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020 and 2025 exist (about 3.96, 4.00, 4.05, 4.11 and 4.20 GB each); 2016 returns 404. The epochs the rule needs (2010, 2015, 2020) were all confirmed present; other epochs were not individually checked.
entries.crs: NAD83 Canada Lambert (README proj4: lcc lat_1=49 lat_2=77 lon_0=-95), i.e. the EPSG:3978 definition
entries.retrieval: HEAD requests only; rasters NOT downloaded
entries.year_selection_rule: epoch = latest SCANFI v2 epoch STRICTLY BEFORE the fire or target year = 5 * floor((year - 1) / 5): 2015 -> 2010, 2016-2020 -> 2015, 2021-2025 -> 2020, 2026 -> 2025. Fires up to 2014 use FBP 2014b instead.
entries.rule_interpretation: Team Lead decision 2026-11-02: strictly before, for ALL lanes, so a fire's own burn scar or same-year disturbance cannot enter the fuel/vegetation layer (a 2020 fire uses the 2015 epoch, a 2025 fire the 2020 epoch). Supersedes the earlier 'at or before' draft. SCANFI v1 has only a 2020 map and v3 is annual fractional land cover without forest height/species/biomass, so neither is used for this rule.
entries.availability_notes: All SCANFI v2 maps were published in 2026, so every historical use is retrospective. SCANFI is a land-cover/forest-attribute product, not an FBP fuel-type raster; the crosswalk is a TODO below. Strictly-before epochs are up to 5 years old for the target year, so fuel change in between (harvest, regrowth, fires in the gap) is not captured; that is an accepted bias of the rule, not measured.
entries.status: rule approved by Team Lead 2026-11-02; crosswalk TODO open

lane_leak_notes.spread: Strictly-before rule applies; the existing capability_2 build used the 2024 FBP map for every fire, which leaks future fuel into 2012-2023 fires and is superseded by this rule once the crosswalk exists.
lane_leak_notes.ignition: No fuel layer is in the v1 panel (AGENTS.md defers fuels and land cover). If added, the same strictly-before rule applies. Terrain (CDEM, 2011 vintage, static ground elevation) has no comparable same-year leak.
lane_leak_notes.fbp_2014b: Its metadata cites NFDB 2016 for burn scars, so fires in 2012-2014 could already be masked in it; the check on fuel inside fire perimeters is still open (see entry).
